guide.title: Admin Guide
guide.subtitle: Complete documentation for using the Ishonchli.uz admin panel
guide.s1_desc: Open the site and click Login in the top navigation bar. Enter the admin credentials below, then click Login.
guide.s1_note: After login, your name appears in the navbar and an Admin link becomes visible. The site defaults to Uzbek — use the UZ / RU / EN switcher in the top-right to change the language.
guide.s2_desc: Click the Admin link in the navbar to enter the admin panel. The dark sidebar on the left contains 5 sections:
guide.s2_note: Use ← Back to Site at the bottom of the sidebar to return to the public site.
s2_rows: Overview stats and pending reports queue
guide.s3_desc: The dashboard is the first screen after entering the admin panel.
s3_cards: All sellers tracked in the system
guide.s3_pending_desc: Below the cards is a live table of the 8 most recent pending reports. Each row shows the type, seller, reporter, date, and a Review link to the full moderation page.
guide.s3_tip: Check this table every time you log in. A growing pending queue means trust scores are stale — buyers see outdated risk levels until you take action.
guide.s4_desc: All reports submitted by users pass through this page before affecting any seller trust score.
s4_cols_rows: Type badge (Fraud/Positive), category, and description preview
Telegram username, marketplace name, or phone number
Full name and email of the submitting user
guide.s4_approve_desc: Report status becomes APPROVED. The seller trust score recalculates immediately. Suspicious and fraudster flags are also re-evaluated.
guide.s4_reject_desc: Report status becomes REJECTED. Rejected reports do NOT affect the seller trust score. Use this for spam, duplicates, or unsubstantiated claims.
guide.s4_delete_desc: Permanently deletes the report after confirmation. Use only for abusive or illegal content.
guide.s4_warning: Only approved reports affect seller trust scores. You must actively review pending reports for the system to reflect reality.
s5_cols: Number of reports this user submitted
guide.s5_make_admin_desc: Promotes the user to ADMIN role. They immediately gain access to this admin panel.
guide.s5_revoke_desc: Reverts the user to USER role. They lose admin panel access. You cannot revoke your own admin status.
guide.s5_delete_desc: Permanently deletes the user and ALL their reports, comments, and votes. Use carefully.
guide.s6_desc: Three interactive charts. Hover over any chart element to see exact numbers.
guide.s6_chart1_desc: Red bars = fraud reports, green bars = positive reviews. Shows last 6 months. Spikes in fraud may indicate a scam campaign.
guide.s6_chart2_desc: Breakdown of fraud types: Scam, Fake Product, Non Delivery, Payment Fraud, Account Theft, Other.
guide.s6_chart3_desc: How many sellers are in each risk level. Green = Safe, Yellow = Moderate, Orange = High, Red = Dangerous.
guide.s7_desc: Read-only page showing the active fraud detection rules. To change values, edit src/lib/trust-score.ts and redeploy.
guide.s8_title: Using the Public Site as Admin
guide.s8_desc: As admin you have full access to the public site. Use ← Back to Site in the sidebar to return.
s8_search_steps: Click Sellers in the navbar or go to /search
Enter a phone number, Telegram username, or marketplace username
Results show as cards with trust score and risk badge
Click any card to open the full seller profile
s8_profile_steps: Shows all contact identifiers (phone, Telegram, marketplace)
Trust score bar with current risk level
Warning banners if seller is flagged as Suspicious or Potential Fraudster
All approved reports listed with full descriptions
s8_report_steps: Full description, category, and status badge
Link back to the seller profile
guide.s9_desc: Every seller starts with a score of 50 when first added. The score recalculates automatically each time you approve or reject a report.
guide.s10_desc: Two automatic flags are applied on top of the trust score to highlight dangerous patterns in real time.
guide.s10_sus_condition: Condition: Seller receives more than 3 fraud complaints within the last 7 days.
guide.s10_sus_effect: Effect: A warning banner appears on the seller profile and search cards.
guide.s10_sus_action: Admin action: Review the recent reports immediately. Approve valid ones to drop the trust score accordingly.
guide.s10_fraud_condition: Condition: Seller has more than 5 approved (confirmed) fraud reports in total.
guide.s10_fraud_effect: Effect: A permanent red banner appears on the seller profile.
guide.s10_fraud_action: Admin action: If reports were made in error, reject them — the flag recalculates automatically.
